verdict.rationale: FreshBooks says you can link your bank account and automate bank reconciliation and transaction management. It sells native payment acceptance (cards, ACH, Apple/Google Pay) and offers embedded FreshBooks Payroll as an add-on. All of this feeds a double-entry ledger with a chart of accounts, so the core story is covered by first-party claims. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how bank-feed transactions and payroll runs post to the ledger, specifics of the third-party payment and payroll integrations among the '100+ integrations', and independent or hands-on corroboration.
